---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
labels: [enhancement]
---

## Summary
Provide a brief summary of the feature request.

## Problem Statement
Explain what problem this feature aims to solve and why it's necessary.

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature and how it should work.

## Use Cases
List specific examples of how this feature would be useful.

## Alternatives Considered
Mention any alternative approaches or workarounds you have considered.

## Challenges & Risks
Highlight any potential difficulties or risks in implementing this feature.

## Priority/Impact Level
Indicate the importance of this feature (e.g., High, Medium, Low).

## Dependencies
Specify if this feature depends on other features, APIs, or third-party tools.

## Implementation Ideas
Suggest potential approaches for implementing this feature.

## User Stories
Describe how different users would interact with this feature. (e.g., "As a user, I want to...")

## Performance Considerations
Mention if this feature could impact speed, resource usage, or scalability.

## Testing Requirements
Define how this feature should be tested to ensure it works correctly.

## Additional Context
Include any relevant information, links, or screenshots that support your request.
